answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the reef of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the anchor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves. The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
